parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 achieved val_bpb 1.011215. Improvement is marginal but consistent. Since increasing capacity worked, I'm moving to ASPECT_RATIO=64 to expand model width and increase total parameters, as I have VRAM headroom.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity/width.
